title: Each profile's response contract is exactly what its supervisor reads and nothing more
asA: operator whose service is probed by a supervisor with a fixed idea of what a probe response looks like
iWant: the response contract to match the supervisor's shape and stay minimal
soThat: the supervisor's parsing never sees an unexpected field and the surface never carries operational detail the supervisor does not read

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `loadBalancer` profile answers with an empty response body and the resolved status code (200 pass, 503 fail).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the `loadBalancer` profile whose readiness predicate is pass, then fail
acceptanceCriteria.when: an HTTP GET is issued against the resolved health path in each state
acceptanceCriteria.then: the pass response has status 200 with content-length 0 and no body; the fail response has status 503 with content-length 0 and no body

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `kubernetes` profile answers with a JSON body of exactly `{"status":"pass"}` or `{"status":"fail"}` and no additional keys.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the `kubernetes` profile with liveness pass and readiness pass, then readiness fail
acceptanceCriteria.when: an HTTP GET is issued against `/live` and `/ready` in each state and the parsed JSON body key set is inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: the parsed body is exactly a one-key object whose only key is `status` and whose value is `pass` or `fail` matching the resolved answer

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `dockerHealthcheck` profile exits with code 0 on pass and a non-zero code on fail; the profile emits no HTTP surface.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configured with `probeInterface.profile: dockerHealthcheck` and the profile's readiness predicate pass, then fail
acceptanceCriteria.when: the profile's healthcheck command entry point is invoked in each state
acceptanceCriteria.then: the pass invocation exits with code 0; the fail invocation exits with a non-zero code; the process opens no HTTP probe listener when this profile is selected

acceptanceCriteria.description: A systemd-profile process under Type=notify emits sd_notify(READY=1) exactly once after boot completes and sd_notify(WATCHDOG=1) at the configured watchdog cadence for the process lifetime; a process that fails to send WATCHDOG within the cadence budget is signalled fail by the systemd supervisor. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent supplies the elicited probe-interface-profile value (systemd or a TCP-transport profile), the systemd watchdog cadence, and the TCP probe port; the AC substitutes those for the illustrative values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configured with probe-interface-profile=systemd, watchdog cadence 10 seconds, and a project-owned readiness predicate returning pass
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and runs for 30 seconds under a mock systemd notify sink
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sink records exactly one READY=1 line after boot and at least two WATCHDOG=1 lines within the 30-second window; if the process is paused past the watchdog budget, the sink records no further WATCHDOG=1 lines and the supervisor pull is signalled

acceptanceCriteria.description: A TCP-transport probe profile answers a TCP socket connect on the configured probe port with an accept on pass and a refuse (RST) on fail; the response is the accept/refuse itself and no bytes are exchanged on the connection. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent supplies the elicited probe-interface-profile value (systemd or a TCP-transport profile), the systemd watchdog cadence, and the TCP probe port; the AC substitutes those for the illustrative values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configured with a TCP-transport profile (a custom profile or a supervising system that reads TCP accept/refuse), probe port 9091, and a readiness predicate returning pass then fail
acceptanceCriteria.when: a supervisor issues one TCP connect while pass, then one TCP connect after the predicate flips to fail
acceptanceCriteria.then: the pass connect completes the three-way handshake and reads zero bytes on the connection before close; the fail connect is refused (RST or connection refused) within the connect timeout; no application-layer data crosses the connection in either case

acceptanceCriteria.description: A process configured with a target-integration profile whose platform adapter is missing (the project has not supplied the systemd notify sink for the systemd profile, or the TCP listener factory for a TCP-transport profile) refuses to boot with the stable-coded PROBE_ADAPTER_MISSING error naming the missing adapter and the profile that requires it.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configured with a systemd profile but without an sd_notify implementation supplied on TAC-1504 selectAdapter
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process exits with a non-zero code and emits PROBE_ADAPTER_MISSING naming the profile (systemd) and the missing adapter (notify implementation); no listener binds
